rv.q: The production, which opened at the Ahmanson Theatre under the direction of Felix Barrett, is brilliantly pulled off.

'Paranormal Activity' is thin to the point of tedium, focused on a couple who've moved from Chicago to England (why England?), hoping for a fresh start, only to find themselves in a dauntingly large two-story house seemingly possessed by evil spirits.
Director Felix Barrett and writer Levi Holloway have devised a crackerjack nightmare for an entire audience to eyewitness.
It's astonishing what can be done live on stage these days, but the effects in PARANORMAL ACTIVITY will blow your mind.

Paranormal Activity: A New Story Live On Stage has defied all my expectations as a genuinely engaging and terrifying experience that will absolutely delight all horror/thriller fans and newcomers alike.
This production is built on “how did they do THAT?” energy, and it delivers.
The team behind Paranormal Activity has achieved something impressive — expanding the scope of what theatre can offer.
All in all, it’s a super fun, eerie, and surprisingly innovative and original night at the theater.

cn.t: Critics praise this stage adaptation for delivering genuine scares and immersive thrills that successfully translate the franchise's escalating dread to live theater through inventive special effects and atmospheric tension.
